name: @belikh/jupiter-github
description: Jupiter for GitHub: light/dark banner, divider, tile, badges and social preview SVGs plus README, profile and org-profile templates, all generated from the design tokens.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-logo.mjs && node scripts/readme-graphics.mjs && node src/make.mjs --assets && node src/make.mjs --logo --title Jupiter --subtitle "One JSON file, every surface" --eyebrow "design system" --footer "belikh/design" --only banner,social --out ../../.github/assets
scripts.png: node src/make.mjs --logo --title Jupiter --subtitle "One JSON file, every surface" --eyebrow "design system" --footer "belikh/design" --only social --png --out ../../.github/assets
